executive_risk_memo: Between August 2024 and November 2026, AUTOfinance (Tokemak Autopools) completed two EOA-to-Safe bootstrap hardening transitions on Ethereum ($27,831,154 single-chain TVL): SystemRegistry (0x2218F90A98b0C070676f249EF44834686dAa4285) moved from deployer EOA ownership to a zero-timelock 6-of-11 Gnosis Safe (0x8b4334d4812C530574Bd4F2763FcD22dE94A969B) after 17.68 days (block 20,765,084; carrying Allowance Module 0xCFbFaC74C26F8647cBDb8c5caf80BB5b32E43134 and three 2025-2026 signer rotations), and the deployer EOA self-revoked DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on immutable AccessController (0x37767cBfF88Cb623E9404e959560984F7D742dF6) after 223.57 days (block 22,239,605; bootstrap hardening mean = 120.63 days, measuring operational handover rather than remediation of any missed deadline). In May 2025, AccessController RBAC oversight expanded to three Safes via 6-of-14 Safe 0xa9900B2d... (42.9% quorum). Regarding governance, security docs state ownership will 'eventually' move to a Governor without setting a deadline, and Snapshot GraphQL (hub.snapshot.org/graphql) confirms space tokemak.eth holds only one 2022 proposal (TRU-1, 181 votes, admin 0x8b4334...) with zero Autopools proposals. Separately, an open 653.10-day documentation discrepancy persists from the pre-replacement 2025-01-21 Wayback archive through live docs: contract-addresses still publishes 2024 SystemSecurity (0x027a...) and SwapRouter (0x6201...), whereas dual-RPC getters at pinned blocks 26,452,182 and 26,452,373 prove live systemSecurity() = 0xe57A2eC5EF4CC7F6576BB1ed5Ec3759878F39B20 and swapRouter() = 0x955b5AdcdBBA6870fECA78338137191F774679cA. Trailing-12-month engineering in Tokemak/v2-core-pub shows 0 commits and bus factor 0 (dormant since 2024-10-16; post-2024 component rotations lack public pre-deployment commits in that repository).

result.method: Batched JSON-RPC reads pinned to the block hash (EIP-1898); EIP-1967 / EIP-1822 / beacon proxies; capabilities from PUSH4 selectors in proxy + implementation bytecode (heuristic).
result.summary: Controlled by a 6-of-11 Safe with no timelock: changes can land instantly once signers agree.

assessment.method: Live bytecode + storage heuristic at the pinned block, cross-checked with Pacta's RPC-pinned record for AUTOfinance (block 26451608).
limits: riskScore (0-100) is a heuristic of the controller type and of pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities read at one block; it is not an audit.

The live check reads EIP-1967 slots, owner(), Safe getThreshold() / getOwners() and TimelockController getMinDelay(); custom role systems, bridge or L2 admin paths and off-chain operations are not resolved.
Documentation is compared only for indexed protocols (catalogMatch), at their pinned block.

upgrade_x402.note: Free tier: 50 pre-flight calls per caller per UTC day (REST and MCP), then $0.01 per call over x402 (HTTP 402, never a dead-end 429). Paid routes below: POST the JSON body with an x402 X-PAYMENT (v1) or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) header.
